concerns.text: The plan cites the MODIS lake‑Powell toy dataset (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/nasa-cisto-data-science-group/modis-lake-powell-toy-dataset/…`) as the environmental covariate source, yet the project’s goal is continental‑scale migration prediction across North America. This toy dataset covers only a small regional extent and therefore cannot provide the required temperature and NDVI values for the full study domain, violating FR‑002/FR‑011 and undermining the scientific validity of the model.
